q1_issues.issue: (MeasureAtLeast (sk_use $x) duration 2 generation) sits in the per-member conclusion, so the rule asserts that each individual Keeper used the crowd rule for at least two generations - the span belongs to the practice across Keepers, not to any one of them.

(Ongoing (sk_use $x)) likewise distributes the continuative aspect to every instance of the kind, asserting an in-progress use for every Keeper, including the past ones the "for generations" span covers.

q2_gaps: a duration / time-span adjunct scoping over a generic practice as a whole ("Ns have V-ed for generations"): the distributing-rule form puts every clause atom into the per-instance conclusion and offers no kind-level carrier for a span that holds of the kind rather than of each member
notes: Correctly avoids the kind-level relation route (the object is a definite singular), and the bare-plural duration's at-least-2 form, the top-level definite crowd_rule witness and the noun-modifier compound (genus only, modifier not exposed) all follow the instruction set; the witness is named sk_rule_1 where its class is crowd_rule.
